pages.title: What it does
pages.text: Freezes creatures you hit, turns water into ice, and turns lava into magma blocks.$(br2)$(bold)$(#7952A6)Requirement:$() Path level 10.

pages.title: Use and limits
pages.text: If you are possessing a creature, the cold affects it too. Block changes are temporary: when they leave the ability’s area, they return to their previous state.
